criticalDefects: Most of the single-word options are bare household-finance vocabulary rather than defensible brands.
The repeated thrift compounds feel generated and several have unnatural modifier order.
Literal constructions such as familyfund and budgetbond describe the category without creating a distinctive identity.
Much of the set sounds stern or institutional rather than warmly supportive for young families.

criticalDefects: Several options simply attach puzzle language to a fashionable suffix or a literal cozy cue.
Threadle reads as a derivative of the Wordle naming pattern rather than an original studio identity.
Some coined forms are awkward to say or parse, especially qubitry, puzzluxe, and knitplay.
The set drifts from thoughtful adult coziness into quantum, mechanical, or generic game-title territory.

literal cozy-puzzle compounds: cozygrid, cozypuzzle, logicnest
common puzzle or structure nouns: mosaic, lattice, cogwheel, jigsaw

Glacielle and edelwise look like conspicuous suffix or spelling manipulations rather than confident inventions.
Cold literal descriptors such as glacial and crystalline can feel clinical or harsh rather than sensorially premium.
